entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Yeah, yeah, just get me someone. This is unbelievable. I want to return this piece of junk you sold me.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. I understand you're calling about a return. Can I get your name and order number to start?
The name is Mark Peterson, order number is VF987-552. And yes, a return. I want my money back for this VeloBand. It's impossible to use.

Okay, Mark, I've pulled up your account. I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with the VeloBand. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

Don't play games with me! It's junk! The whole interface is so **confusing**, it's practically useless. I read the entire **user manual** cover to cover, and it's still **hard to use**. I really **expected more** from a VeloFit product. Are you going to process this return or do I need to speak to your manager and light up your social media with reviews?
There's no need for that, sir. I can definitely look into the return eligibility for you. Let me just check our policy against your delivery date. One moment please.
(Muttering) Okay... checking the internal knowledge base... standard policy is 90 days.
Alright, Mark, thank you for your patience. I see here that the item was delivered 39 days ago, on December 15th.
So? Get on with it. I don't have all day.
Of course. According to our return policy, you are well within the 90-day window. I can absolutely approve this return for a full refund for you right now.
Finally! See? Was that so hard? Just send me the return label. And it better be prepaid.

Yes, absolutely. I've just initiated the process. A prepaid shipping label has been sent to the email address on file. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's it. About time I got some actual service.
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
